summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The ALPS Disruptive Technologies ETF (DTEC) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Indxx Disruptive Technologies index. The fund tracks an index of 100 global companies that are involved in disruptive technologies across 10 themes. DTEC was launched on Dec 29, 2017 and is issued by SS&C.

holdings.infoBox: DTEC is an equity ETF with a total of 101 individual holdings. The top holdings are Tempus AI stock at 1.43%, Caris Life Sciences at 1.30%, Rubrik at 1.25%, CrowdStrike Holdings at 1.23%, and Zscaler at 1.20%.
